notes.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns June 2023 Update
notes.content:
Please make sure to restart your game to ensure that you’ve downloaded the latest version and continue to submit any bug reports to support.2k.com.


GENERAL
- Stability & performance improvements
- Mission cards can now be added to the hand even when there are the maximum number of cards present in the hand
- Fix for Mission Rewards not showing on Victory Screen
- Hero Deck screen now properly checks for new collar and suit passives
- Charlie's stats will now scale properly with the Hunter's Champion Level stat bonuses
- Charlie navigation improvements for the Abbey
- "Upgrade ability" objective during "No Place Like Home" mission now completes when any ability is upgraded
- Fix for achievements / trophies not being rewarded as intended


HEROES
- Venom Combos will now consume Ravenous 


NEW GAME+
- Fixed reported issue of Nest Mother and Summoning Circle missions not appearing during Act 1 of NG+ campaigns
- Toggles have been added to customize the New Game+ experience and choose progression to carry over!
- Hero Abilities: Includes hero cards and abilities, including Hunter Collars and Passives
- Friendship Levels: Includes hero and team friendship levels and rewards
- Resources: Includes Credits, Essence, Blueprints, Intel, Gloss, and Arcane Knowledge
- Cosmetics: Includes unlocked cosmetics, with purchased cosmetics immediately available


STEAM DECK
- Steam Deck performance & stability improvements

notes.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns May 2023 Update
notes.content:
Please make sure to restart your game to ensure that you’ve downloaded the latest version and continue to submit any bug reports to [url=https://support.2k.com/hc/en-us]support.2k.com[/url].
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Stability, performance, & load time improvements
[*] Texture improvements
[*] Global fix for missing & cut off voice overs
[*] Adjustments to level lighting to make shadows clearer so the characters don't appear to float
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added feature to individually select language for audio & subtitles
[*] Increased font size for subtitles
[/list]
[h3][b]HEROES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Doctor Strange: Agamotto’s Gaze will now properly apply the bonus card play
[*] Morbius: Savage Swipe will now only trigger the Speed Kills achievement/trophy when the conditions for gaining Quick are satisfied
[*] Storm: Multiple fixes to Live Wire heroic ability
[/list]
[h3][b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Game Difficulty dropdown to T.H.R.E.A.T. Room screen
[*] Enemies recovering from being stunned now correctly indicate which hero they’re planning to attack
[*] Color of saved HDR photos now correct when viewing them in gallery
[*] Fixed reported issue where reentering Superlink would center the Gallery or Messages but focus the Timeline
[*] Fixed reported issues caused by favoriting and deleting photos on both the standalone and Superlink gallery screens
[*] Purchased hero suits can now be equipped when offline
[*] Charlie follow tutorial will now show the first time you tell Charlie to follow you
[*] Big Guns achievement/trophy will no longer count duped abilities as being different[/list]
[h3][b]GLOBAL COOLDOWN[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added condition to prevent more than one enemy unit from forecasting Sacrifice ability per turn
[*] Fixed cooldown check to look at all units instead of just at self, to prevent Sacrifice ability being used in back-to-back turns
[/list]
[h3][b]STEAM DECK[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Texture and resolution improvements
[*] Setting deck-specific defaults in the video tab
[*] Stability fix for playing with everything turned up to Epic
[/list]

notes.title: Marvel's Midnight Suns March 2023 Update
notes.content:
Please make sure to restart your game to ensure that you've downloaded the latest version and continue to submit any bug reports and feedback to [url=https://support.2k.com/hc/en-us]support.2k.com[/url].

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] General bug fixes and performance improvements
[*] Improvements regarding enemies falling through the map
[*] Level of detail improvements across all maps and the Abbey
[*] Crash reductions and improvements
[*] General audio fixes
[*] Improvements with physical collisions
[*] Texture popping improvements
[*] Foliage improvements
[*] Reduced hitches in dialogues and sequences
[/list]

[b]Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Venom tongue error display
[*] Offensive Rush status effect will no longer appear multiple times in a single encounter, and the UI will no longer display a turn counter
[*] Add support to missions so that a modifier can be applied to the number of times a Hero is KO'd
[*] Targeting fixes for Deadpool's Pain Piñata with improved move-to-range-of-cursor targeting
[*] Changed the Hunter's Balanced Collar to require 4 Power card plays (up from 3) to resolve infinite XP loop exploit
[*] Mission cards will now always properly spawn in the final mission
[*] Added a way to flag cards as pending discards so that they don't count against the hand limit during ability effect execution
[*] Hex Charge now removes any pre-existing Taunt effect on the target 
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] Created and added sort dropdown to Ability Inventory
[*] Added missing objectives on Day 11
[*] Fix for controller not working on initial showing of ability choice screen
[*] Fix for unfocusable scrollbox scrolling in online screens specifically for console long descriptions
[*] Some setting tweaks related to low memory ray tracing and Steam Deck autodetect
[/list]

notes.title: An Update from the Dev Team - First Patch Now Available
notes.content:
A new update for [i]Marvel's Midnight Suns[/i] is available on Windows PC. Please make sure to restart your game to ensure that you've downloaded the latest version and continue to submit any bug reports and feedback to[url=https://support.2k.com/] [/url][url=https://support.2k.com/][b]support.2k.com[/b][/url]. Details include:

[h3]General[/h3]
●      Includes various bug fixes and adjustments to improve stability and performance
●      Addresses the Hero Ops progression bug
●      Fixes game crashes when attempting a manual save
●      Fixes Magik standing on the chair while speaking to her in Wanda’s Room

[h3]Combat[/h3]
●      Capture Agent general missions will now grant 3 stars if they are completed in 3 turns (up from 2)
●      Fixed tracking for multi-detonate kills against Intel Challenges
●      Non-damaging knockback attacks no longer trigger Lilin Guardian's Rage
●      Magik's "Reinforcements" ability will now Draw the proper card amount on Play
●      Heroes will now have "Vulnerable" for correct number of turns when a "Moderate" Injury is applied
●      Nest Mother should now Summon Altars at the start of each mission
●      Improved hitches during specific combat actions, like Vaulting

[h3]Photo Mode fixes[/h3]
●      Ensure clothing settles when changing poses
●      Ghost Rider's flame head effects render correctly
●      Effects remain if Depth of Field is changed

notes.title: Firaxis Live Streams: Rise Up With The Midnight Suns!
notes.content:
With the December 2 release of Marvel's Midnight Suns fast approaching, members of the Firaxis development team recently took time out of their busy schedules to appear on a series of live streams. The ensuing card-based combat during [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/gameplay/tactical-missions/]tactical missions[/url] afforded great opportunities to see [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes]heroes[/url] including [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/blade/]Blade[/url], [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/magik/]Magik[/url], [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/heroes/wolverine/]Wolverine[/url], and others show off their skills on the battlefield and learn more about the numerous activities that you can enjoy in and around [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/the-abbey]the Abbey[/url] between battles. 

If you missed out on any of the action-packed gameplay and developer insights that were shared during these live streams, you can watch archives of all four below.
 
[h2]Live Stream #4[/h2]
Hulk is shown for the first time after being revealed as the 13th (late-game unlockable) hero on the base game's Midnight Suns roster, and Creative Director Jake Solomon attempts to beat a tactical mission on the hardest of Marvel's Midnight Suns' eight difficulty settings. 

[previewyoutube=q8M1_JsU8AE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #3[/h2]
Members of the Firaxis development team share a first look at some of the activities you can enjoy when you're not battling Lilith's demonic forces. Also, Senior Franchise Producer Garth DeAngelis almost gets beaten at his own game while playing through one of three very different tactical missions.  

 [previewyoutube=N_7xlhN34ts;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #2[/h2]
Join the Firaxis developers for a deep dive into strategic combat as they play through tactical missions and discuss how heroes and their respective [url=https://midnightsuns.2k.com/game-guide/gameplay/hero-abilities/]ability cards[/url] can be upgraded as you progress through the game. Later, Deadpool, Venom, Morbius, and Storm are revealed as the four heroes joining the roster in the Season Pass DLC next year.

 [previewyoutube=diwl2GrC4FI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Live Stream #1[/h2]
Creative Director Jake Solomon and Senior Franchise Producer Garth DeAngelis play through two tactical missions while discussing combat mechanics, how the Midnight Suns roster was chosen, why heroes' abilities are represented by cards, and more. 

[previewyoutube=5ZXuxi70d70;full][/previewyoutube]
